sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract, as long-term stability is a cornerstone of our twelve-year partnership. In return for the extended 24-month term, we are prepared to offer a revised price of €52.10 per unit. 

For our complete Angebot, we propose a price of €52.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot is valid for 30 days.

While our colleagues will address your request regarding cost transparency, please understand that as a family-run foundry, we maintain strict confidentiality over our internal calculations. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

It has been a privilege to work alongside Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years, but we are surprised to see your proposed price decrease from your previous offer, which does not reflect the mutual steps needed to reach an agreement. As a family-run foundry, our policy is firm and we will not share our internal cost breakdowns under any circumstances. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

We maintain our offer of a price of €52.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days. We maintain our offer of €52.10 for a 24-month contract and ask you to return to a constructive negotiation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
